nodes.label: ADR 0026: Tenant Deletion & GDPR Workflow
nodes.rationale: Two-stage delete: (1) soft delete — write tenant_deletions row with hard_delete_after=now+30d, set paymentStatus='cancelled'; (2) hard delete — daily cron sweeper at 0 3 * * * drops Neon project and deletes organizations row. Restore: super_admin stamps restored_at within 30 days, flips paymentStatus='active'. Export: JSON dump per tenant table, base64-encoded, stored in tenant_deletions.export_url (stop-gap; R2 upgrade required at scale). Neon project DELETE is synchronous and irreversible.
alternatives_rejected: CSV-per-table export (Cloudflare Workers no built-in ZIP encoder)

nodes.label: tenant_deletions table + two-stage delete (30-day soft, then hard)
